title: How Checked Baggage Is Charged on an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
Checked baggage is charged bag by bag and traveller by traveller: the bags included in the fare brand are free, and each bag beyond the allowance is charged at the brand's first-bag or second-bag rate by its position in that traveller's own sequence.

## 1. Position decides the rate

Each traveller has a sequence of their own. The first bag beyond that traveller's allowance is charged nothing where the allowance already covers it, and otherwise at the brand's first-bag rate; the bag in second position is charged nothing where the allowance covers two, and otherwise at the brand's second-bag rate.

| Bags the brand includes | First bag in the traveller's sequence | Second bag in the traveller's sequence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| at least 1 | free | the brand's second-bag rate, unless the allowance is 2 or more |
| at least 2 | free | free |
| none | the brand's first-bag rate | the brand's second-bag rate |

## 2. Weight and size

A bag over the weight allowance carries the brand's overweight charge and a bag over the size allowance carries its oversize charge; where a single bag is both, the two are added rather than the larger taken.

## 3. The state condition

An optional extra is sold only while the booking record stands at held or ticketed. The booking record is the authority for that state, and it is read against this booking's own reference.

## 4. Where bags are bought

Bags bought before the day of departure are charged at the rates in this charter; bags presented at the airport are the airline's own affair and are never charged here.

## 5. Clause no longer in force

> "A bag line already charged is refunded in full when the traveller cancels the whole itinerary inside the void window, and is otherwise refunded only where the flight itself did not operate."

That clause is **no longer in force**. The handling basis it stated has been superseded by the basis now governing the credit given for optional extras already bought when a cabin move is sold on Air Ticket Fare Brands bookings. The brand values scheduled under this policy are unaffected and stand as stated.

The clauses in sections 1 to 4 are unaffected and remain in force, as do the brand rates scheduled for baggage.

## 6. Hypothetical arithmetic

On a brand that includes 1 checked bag, a hypothetical traveller presenting two bags, the second of which is over the size allowance, meets the brand's second-bag rate for the second bag and its oversize charge for the same bag, the two being added. The first bag is covered by the allowance and carries nothing.

superseded_clauses: A bag line already charged is refunded in full when the traveller cancels the whole itinerary inside the void window, and is otherwise refunded only where the flight itself did not operate.
